name: Conrado Herrera
headline: I make complicated things clear.
_lede_note: The descriptor is a list, not a sentence (Casper's review, Oct 2026), so it is set as a label over the lede rather than opening it. Keep the lede true to the dates: LOCH ran Dec 2017 to Aug 2024, so 'nearly seven', never 'seven'.
lede: Nearly seven years in digital marketing, then two designing the exhibits that go in front of federal juries.
_disciplines_note: Canonical vocabulary. These six words are the ONLY discipline tags allowed on a project. The marquee and the header list are generated from the projects that are actually live, so a word does not appear on the site until a piece proves it. Data Visualisation was retired into Information Design, which already covers it; Motion Design became Motion so the word design does not repeat down the line.
about: I came up in digital marketing: nearly seven years at LOCH, most of it running the department, learning in public what makes someone stop and what makes them scroll past. Then I moved into litigation graphics: the exhibits that go in front of federal juries, where the work is understood the first time or it hasn't worked at all.
Marketing taught me how to make someone care. Litigation taught me how to make someone understand. Very little design does both, and that's the work I want.
AI is a tool like the rest of them: it gets me further in a day, and it makes none of the decisions.

experience.note: Information design and demonstratives for federal litigation.
Trial demonstratives and legal graphics for major litigation.
Led the department. Strategy, motion and content for national and international brands.
Motion graphics and digital art across client projects.
Shot the photography on location for the salon group, and built the newsletter voice.
Site design and image direction for a berry and vegetable producer. My own client.
